summary.headline: Astrological Questions, Chapters 91–104
summary.text: Astrological chapter list from a codex, covering thoughts, succession, brothers, decans, synodic degrees with the Sun, wealth, exiles, debt, lands, tenants, plants, partnership, lawsuits, rumors, and a wife’s return. Notes cite Kronos, Apomasar, Massallas, Codex Bononiensis 18, and Codex Florentinus 11, while recording changes of hand and disturbed chapter order.
